homepage.title: ModelSaber
homepage.subtitle: A collection of various assets for use within Beat Saber.

verified.title: This asset has been verified by the ModelSaber team and is safe to use!
verified.description: Verified assets have been checked for malware and are safe to use. Look for the green checkmark!

unverified.title: This asset has not been verified by the ModelSaber team. Use at your own risk!
unverified.description: Unverified assets have not been checked for malware. Be cautious when downloading and using these assets.

assets.nsfwWarning: This asset is marked as NSFW.

upload.createAssetSubtitle: Please fill out the form below to upload a new asset to ModelSaber.
upload.thumbnailRuleList1: Must be a square image (1:1 aspect ratio).
upload.thumbnailFooter: Please ensure your thumbnail follows the rules listed above.
upload.ensureRights: Please ensure that you have the rights to upload this asset to ModelSaber.

preview.noAudioSupport: Your browser does not support the audio element.
preview.noPreviewAvailable: No preview available for this asset.
preview.textOnlySr: This preview only shows the content within the file. If you wish to read it, please download the file and open it with your system.

createProject.title: Create Project
createProject.subtitle: Please fill out the form below to create a new project.
createProject.name: Name
createProject.thumbnailRuleList1: Must be a square image (1:1 aspect ratio).
createProject.thumbnailFooter: Please ensure your thumbnail follows the rules listed above.

createVersion.title: Create Version for {projectName}
createVersion.subtitle: Please fill out the form below to create a new version for {projectName}.
createVersion.semverShouldMatchManifest: The semantic version should match the version specified in your manifest.json file.
createVersion.importFromOtherVersionDialogDescription: Select another version of {projectName} to import dependencies from. This will copy all dependencies from the selected version to the new version you are creating.
createVersion.packingFileIntoZip: Your DLL file will be packed into a zip file upon upload in the Plugins folder. If you want to include additional files, or if your DLL should be placed in a different folder, please create a zip file with the correct structure and upload that instead.

manifestChecks.couldNotReadManifest: Could not read manifest from file. Please ensure it is a valid .dll or .zip file containing a manifest.json.
manifestChecks.manifestProjectNameMismatch: The name specified in your manifest ({manifestName}) doesn't match the name of the project you're uploading to ({expectedName}). Please ensure the 'name' field in your manifest matches the name of your project on ModelSaber.

dependencies.manifestMissingdependsOn: Your manifest is missing the 'dependsOn' field, which is required to specify your mod's dependencies. Please add this field to your manifest and try again.
dependencies.webInvalidRange: Dependency {depName} has an invalid game version range specified: {sv}. Please ensure all dependencies have valid semantic version ranges.
dependencies.manifestInvalidRange: Dependency {depName} has an invalid game version range specified: {sv}. Please ensure all dependencies in your manifest have valid semantic version ranges.
dependencies.webDependencyNotFound: Dependency {depName}@{sv} was not found in the manifest. Please ensure all dependencies listed are included in the manifest file.
dependencies.manifestDependencyNotFound: Dependency {depName}@{sv} specified in manifest not found. Please ensure all dependencies listed in your manifest are marked as dependencies on ModelSaber.

manifestChecks.manifestGameVersionIsntLowest: The game version specified in your manifest ({manifestGameVersion}) isn't the lowest game version specified among your supported game versions. Please ensure the 'gameVersion' field in your manifest specifies the lowest game version your mod supports, or update your supported game versions to match the game version specified in your manifest.

requests.wouldYouLikeToAcceptOrReject: Would you like to accept or reject this request?
requests.initialMessageCredit: {name} would like to add you as a collaborator to the asset {assetName}.
requests.initialMessageLink: {name} would like to link your asset, {toLinkAssetName}, to their asset, {assetName}.
requests.noMessagesFound: No messages found for this request.

approvalDialog.title: Update Status for {name}
approvalDialog.description: Select the new status for the asset "{name}". Click save to apply the changes.
approvalDialog.reasonWillBeVisible: This reason will be visible to the author of {name}.

downloadDialog.title: Download Unverified Asset?
downloadDialog.description: The asset you are trying to download has not been verified by the ModelSaber team. Unverified assets may contain malware or other harmful content. Are you sure you want to proceed with the download?
downloadDialog.neverShowAgain: If you'd like to never see this warning again, please click the "Don't show again" button.

reportDialog.title: Report {name}
reportDialog.description: If you believe this asset violates our rules, please provide a reason for reporting it. Our moderation team will review the report and take appropriate action if necessary.
reportDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Enter reason for reporting this asset

linkAssetDialog.title: Add a Related Asset
linkAssetDialog.description: Link another asset as related to this one by entering the link to the asset's page below.

altFormat.title: Alternative Format
altFormat.description: Same asset in a different file format (e.g. a saber in the .saber and .wacker formats)

altDesign.title: Alternative Design
altDesign.description: A different design or version of the same asset (e.g. a saber with a different color scheme or model)

newerVersion.title: Newer Version
newerVersion.description: A more recent version of the asset, typically with improvements or updates

olderVersion.title: Older Version
olderVersion.description: A previous version of of the asset released before the current one
